name: Seismitoad
description: The vibrating of the bumps all over its body causes earthquake-like tremors. Seismitoad and Croagunk are similar species.

moves.name: Drain Punch
moves.description: An energy-draining punch. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Growl
moves.description: The user growls in an endearing way, making opposing Pokémon less wary. This lowers their Attack stats.

moves.name: Supersonic
moves.description: The user generates odd sound waves from its body that confuse the target.

moves.name: Acid
moves.description: Opposing Pokémon are attacked with a spray of harsh acid. This may also lower their Sp. Def stats.

moves.name: Gastro Acid
moves.description: The user hurls up its stomach acids on the target. The fluid eliminates the effect of the target’s Ability.

moves.name: Echoed Voice
moves.description: The user attacks the target with an echoing voice. If this move is used every turn, its power is increased.

moves.name: Mud Shot
moves.description: The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud at the target. This also lowers the target’s Speed stat.

moves.name: Round
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a song. Others can join in the Round to increase the power of the attack.

moves.name: Bubble Beam
moves.description: A spray of bubbles is forcefully ejected at the target. This may also lower the target’s Speed stat.

moves.name: Flail
moves.description: The user flails about aimlessly to attack. The less HP the user has, the greater the move’s power.

moves.name: Uproar
moves.description: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. During that time, no Pokémon can fall asleep.

moves.name: Aqua Ring
moves.description: The user envelops itself in a veil made of water. It regains some HP every turn.

moves.name: Hyper Voice
moves.description: The user lets loose a horribly echoing shout with the power to inflict damage.

moves.name: Muddy Water
moves.description: The user attacks by shooting muddy water at opposing Pokémon. This may also lower their accuracy.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type moves. It lowers the power of Fire-type moves.

moves.name: Hydro Pump
moves.description: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

moves.name: Mega Punch
moves.description: The target is slugged by a punch thrown with muscle-packed power.

moves.name: Ice Punch
moves.description: The target is punched with an icy fist. This may also leave the target frozen.

moves.name: Mega Kick
moves.description: The target is attacked by a kick launched with muscle-packed power.

moves.name: Hydro Pump
moves.description: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

moves.name: Surf
moves.description: The user attacks everything around it by swamping its surroundings with a giant wave.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.description: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can’t move on the next turn.

moves.name: Low Kick
moves.description: A powerful low kick that makes the target fall over. The heavier the target, the greater the move’s power.

moves.name: Earthquake
moves.description: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.

moves.name: Dig
moves.description: The user burrows into the ground, then attacks on the next turn.

moves.name: Screech
moves.description: An earsplitting screech harshly lowers the target’s Defense stat.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status conditions.

moves.name: Rock Slide
moves.description: Large boulders are hurled at opposing Pokémon to inflict damage. This may also make the opposing Pokémon flinch.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its HP. The substitute serves as the user’s decoy.

moves.name: Snore
moves.description: This attack can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Sludge Bomb
moves.description: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: Icy Wind
moves.description: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. This also lowers opposing Pokémon’s Speed stats.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Attract
moves.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type moves. It lowers the power of Fire-type moves.

moves.name: Uproar
moves.description: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. During that time, no Pokémon can fall asleep.

moves.name: Hail
moves.description: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except Ice types.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: This attack move doubles its power if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

moves.name: Brick Break
moves.description: The user attacks with a swift chop. It can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.

moves.name: Dive
moves.description: Diving on the first turn, the user floats up and attacks on the next turn.

moves.name: Hyper Voice
moves.description: The user lets loose a horribly echoing shout with the power to inflict damage.

moves.name: Weather Ball
moves.description: This attack move varies in power and type depending on the weather.

moves.name: Rock Tomb
moves.description: Boulders are hurled at the target. This also lowers the target’s Speed stat by preventing its movement.

moves.name: Muddy Water
moves.description: The user attacks by shooting muddy water at opposing Pokémon. This may also lower their accuracy.

moves.name: Bounce
moves.description: The user bounces up high, then drops on the target on the second turn. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Mud Shot
moves.description: The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud at the target. This also lowers the target’s Speed stat.

moves.name: Payback
moves.description: The user stores power, then attacks. If the user moves after the target, this attack’s power will be doubled.

moves.name: Fling
moves.description: The user flings its held item at the target to attack. This move’s power and effects depend on the item.

moves.name: Poison Jab
moves.description: The target is stabbed with a tentacle, arm, or the like steeped in poison. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: Drain Punch
moves.description: An energy-draining punch. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Focus Blast
moves.description: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Earth Power
moves.description: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.description: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user can’t move on the next turn.

moves.name: Power Whip
moves.description: The user violently whirls its vines, tentacles, or the like to harshly lash the target.

moves.name: Stealth Rock
moves.description: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the opposing team. The trap hurts opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

moves.name: Grass Knot
moves.description: The user snares the target with grass and trips it. The heavier the target, the greater the move’s power.

moves.name: Venoshock
moves.description: The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid. This move’s power is doubled if the target is poisoned.

moves.name: Sludge Wave
moves.description: The user strikes everything around it by swamping the area with a giant sludge wave. This may also poison those hit.

moves.name: Round
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a song. Others can join in the Round to increase the power of the attack.

moves.name: Scald
moves.description: The user shoots boiling hot water at its target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Bulldoze
moves.description: The user strikes everything around it by stomping down on the ground. This lowers the Speed stats of those hit.

moves.name: Venom Drench
moves.description: Opposing Pokémon are drenched in an odd poisonous liquid. This lowers the Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats of a poisoned target.

moves.name: Stomping Tantrum
moves.description: Driven by frustration, the user attacks the target. If the user’s previous move has failed, the power of this move doubles.

moves.name: Liquidation
moves.description: The user slams into the target using a full-force blast of water. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.
